quality_policy.note: The gates enforce a Q1-targeting evidence floor; no software can guarantee novelty, peer-review acceptance or doctoral admission.

intake.author_task: Capture only user-confirmed goals, constraints, budget, compute, schedule, application routes, exclusions and ethical boundaries. Leave unknown material facts explicit. Do not approve or advance the gate.

topic-intelligence.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; at least 3 dated primary evidence items; comparative novelty; at least 2 current Q1 SCI/SCIE target venues per direction.
topic-intelligence.author_task: Research at least three serious topic candidates using current primary sources, literature, patents and market/position evidence where relevant. Preserve search queries, inclusion and rejection reasons, uncertainty, the core thesis A and independent extension B. Do not claim novelty from absence alone.

paper-architecture.hard_floor: Every paper must score >= 8.0 on novelty, distinct contribution, significance, feasibility, methodological rigor and Q1 fit; overall >= 8.5; >=2 Q1 SCI/SCIE targets and a falsifiable contribution.
paper-architecture.author_task: Build the complete paper map and one testable contract per configured paper. Give every paper a distinct question, falsification condition, non-overlapping contribution, dependencies, shared assets and fallback logic. Reject salami slicing.

experiment-design.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; the design must support a Q1-level claim with baselines, ablations, uncertainty/statistics, leakage controls, reproducibility and feasible compute/data.
experiment-design.author_task: Produce licensed dataset manifests, a machine-executable experiment plan and hard budget. Pre-register hypotheses, splits, leakage controls, baselines, ablations, metrics, seeds, uncertainty, stopping rules and negative-result handling. Never confirm a license for the human.

experiment-execution.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; observed evidence must support the scientific contribution, robustness, statistics and reproducibility expected by a Q1 reviewer. Failed and negative runs remain visible.
experiment-execution.author_task: Execute only the exact G3-approved plan through scripts/experiment_runner.py. Preserve failed attempts, immutable configuration, output hashes and negative results. Build the claim-evidence matrix and reproducibility report without selecting favorable runs.

writing-and-review.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; selected venue must be current JCR Q1 SCI/SCIE with IF >1.0; two adversarial review rounds have no unresolved fatal findings.
writing-and-review.author_task: Work only on state.active_paper. Write from the claim-evidence matrix, run citation and venue compliance audits, preserve two review rounds and itemized responses, and complete disclosure records. Never invent citations, results, authorship or venue status, and never submit.
